skills.does: Count how long until a date, or how long since one, from today. Takes the one date.
examples: how many days till my sister's wedding on nov 14

skills.does: Today's date and the current time, in your own time zone.
examples: what time is it in tokyo

skills.does: List every date between two dates, optionally stepping by weeks or months.
examples: the first of each month from january to april 2026

skills.does: Name the weekday a date lands on — a Monday, a Saturday.
examples: what day of the week is 14 November 2026

skills.does: Which numbered day of the year a date is, and how much of the year is left.
examples: what day of the year is 2026-11-14
which day of the year is christmas 2026
day of year for 2024-03-01 in a leap year

skills.does: Count the days from one given date to another. Takes both dates.
examples: how many days between 12 July 2026 and 25 December 2026
how long is my trip if I fly out 3 April and back 17 April, counting both days

skills.does: Say how many days long a given month is.
Turn a raw number of seconds into readable words like "1h 30m".
examples: what is 5400 seconds as a duration
how long is 90 seconds in words

skills.does: List the dates a repeating schedule falls on — the first Thursday monthly, every fortnight, every 90 days.
examples: the 1st of every month for six months from 2026-10-01

skills.does: Rewrite a date in a layout you choose, like DD/MM/YYYY or "D MMMM YYYY".
examples: write that date as D MMMM YYYY
show christmas as DDDD, D MMM

skills.does: Say whether a year is a leap year, and how many days it has.
Convert a calendar date and clock time to a Unix epoch number.
Number the week of the year a date sits in, and when that week begins.
examples: which week of the year is christmas 2026

skills.does: Say whether a date is a weekend or a working day.
Show the local time and UTC offset in several time zones at once.
examples: show the time in London Tokyo and New York
list utc offsets for these zones
what time is it in Sydney and Los Angeles

skills.does: Merge overlapping or touching ranges into the fewest that cover the same ground.
examples: merge a range fully inside another

skills.does: Find the date of the next Monday, Tuesday and so on — or the most recent one.
examples: what date is the next friday

skills.does: Read a messy date — "14 nov", "3/4/2026", "next Tuesday" is a different skill — and return it as an ISO date.
examples: what is 14 nov as a date

skills.does: Read "2h 15m" or "2 days 4 hours" and give the total in seconds.
examples: how long is 45 minutes in seconds

skills.does: Turn a relative date like "next Tuesday", "in 3 weeks" or "a month ago" into a real date.
examples: what is the date in 3 weeks
what date was a month ago

skills.does: Say how long ago a date was, or how far off it is, in plain words like "3 days ago".
Turn a Unix timestamp into a readable date and time.
Find the point at which one option starts to pay off against another.
examples: when does the subscription beat paying per use
break even between buying and renting

skills.does: Work out the expected value of a set of outcomes and their probabilities.
examples: expected value of a coin flip for 100 or minus 50
what is the expected value of this lottery

skills.does: Add up weighted pros and cons and show the balance.
examples: weigh up these pros and cons
score my pros and cons list

skills.does: Score options against weighted criteria and rank them, from scores you provide.
examples: help me choose between two flats on price and commute

skills.does: Reduce a width by a height to its screen ratio, like 16:9.
Find the colour opposite a given one on the colour wheel.
Work out the contrast ratio between two colours and whether it meets WCAG AA or AAA.
examples: contrast between black text and white background
is this text readable on that background
check contrast of grey on white

skills.does: Convert a colour between hex, RGB and HSL.
Shade a colour towards black by a percentage.
Build a colour palette around a base colour — analogous, triadic, complementary or tints and shades.
Tint a colour towards white by a percentage.
Blend two colours together in a proportion you choose.
Find the closest CSS colour name to a colour — what you would call it in words.
examples: what colour name is closest to #556B2F

skills.does: Restate a pixel measurement in rem, against the root font size.
Work out how many pixels a rem value comes to on screen.
Resize a width and height to fit a target, keeping the same proportions.
Say which of two version numbers is the newer.
